fidelity: F2a — Equivalent-Circuit + Lumped Oil/Winding Thermal ODE
source: Fitzgerald, Kingsley & Umans (2003) Electric Machinery 6th ed., Ch.2; IEEE Std C57.91-2011 Loading Guide; IEC 60076-7:2018; Kulkarni & Khaparde (2004) Transformer Engineering

unit.name: Generic 100 MVA 110/20 kV ONAF Grid Transformer — Physics-Lumped Equivalent Circuit

R_pu.note: Series equivalent resistance (copper) referred to rating; R_pu = P_load_loss/S_rated. Fitzgerald Ch.2

X_pu.note: Series leakage reactance (pu). Typical 100 MVA transformer 8-12%. Kulkarni & Khaparde

Rc_pu.note: Shunt core-loss (magnetizing) resistance; large -> small no-load loss. Rc_pu = V_pu^2/P_core_pu

Xm_pu.note: Shunt magnetizing reactance; large -> small magnetizing current. Fitzgerald Ch.2

P_no_load_W.note: Core (no-load) loss at rated voltage (eddy + hysteresis, Steinmetz)

P_load_loss_W.note: Copper (load) loss at rated current and 75 degC reference

core_voltage_exponent.note: Core loss ~ (V/Vrated)^n, n~2 for B^2 (V^2) dominance

delta_theta_oil_rated_K.note: Top-oil temperature rise above ambient at rated load (IEEE C57.91 Table 4 ONAF)

delta_theta_hs_gradient_K.note: Hot-spot-to-top-oil gradient at rated current (IEEE C57.91)

n_oil.note: Top-oil rise exponent (IEEE C57.91: 0.8 ONAN, 0.9-1.0 ONAF/forced)

m_wind.note: Winding exponent for hot-spot gradient (IEEE C57.91)

tau_oil_min.note: Top-oil thermal time constant (IEEE C57.91 Annex G typical)
